title: stellularia media
intro: Stellularia media, commonly known as Chrysanthemum morifolium or Cornflower, is a flowering plant species native to Asia. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its purported health benefits, including reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Stellularia media include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antiseptic agent, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions such as fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Stellularia media include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
